name: o-full-clip
description: Clip of the whole-dish seed-3 run's key phase: loaded from its snapshot at 1800 s (o-full_s3), heavy pulses as before until 200 s, then a .webm of run time 200..600 s (sim 2000..2400: the membranes go and the colony booms in o-full_s3) at MAX; during the clip the heavy spring drips once for 40 s (the same tenth of a spring, front-loaded: events inside a clip wait for its end).
